# infisical_secret_validation_rules (Data Source)

Fetch the secret validation rules of an Infisical project. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}


data "infisical_secret_validation_rules" "rules" {
  project_id = "<project-id>"

  # Omit to return every rule in the project, of any type
  type = "static-secrets"
}

output "secret-validation-rules" {
  value = data.infisical_secret_validation_rules.rules.rules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Infisical project to read secret validation rules from.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Return only the rules of this type. Omit to return every rule in the project. Supported: static-secrets, dynamic-secrets, secret-rotations.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The secret validation rules of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `constraints` (Attributes) The constraints the rule enforces. Only the attributes that apply to the rule's type are set; the rest are null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--constraints))
- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the secret validation rule.
- `environment` (Attributes) The environment the rule is scoped to. Null when the rule is enforced in every environment of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--environment))
- `id` (String) The ID of the secret validation rule.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced.
- `name` (String) The name of the secret validation rule.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the rule belongs to.
- `secret_path` (String) The secret path the rule is scoped to.
- `type` (String) The type of the rule: static-secrets, dynamic-secrets or secret-rotations.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.constraints`

Read-Only:

- `key_constraints` (Attributes) Constraints enforced on the secret key. Set only on static-secrets rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--constraints--key_constraints))
- `password_constraints` (Attributes) Constraints the generated password must satisfy. Set only on dynamic-secrets and secret-rotations rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--constraints--password_constraints))
- `providers` (Set of String) The providers the rule applies to. Set only on dynamic-secrets and secret-rotations rules.
- `value_constraints` (Attributes) Constraints enforced on the secret value. Set only on static-secrets rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--constraints--value_constraints))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--constraints--key_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.constraints.key_constraints`

Read-Only:

- `max_length` (Number) The maximum number of characters the secret key may contain.
- `min_length` (Number) The minimum number of characters the secret key must contain.
- `regex_pattern` (String) A regular expression the secret key must match.
- `required_prefix` (String) A string the secret key must start with.
- `required_suffix` (String) A string the secret key must end with.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--constraints--password_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.constraints.password_constraints`

Read-Only:

- `max_length` (Number) The maximum number of characters the generated password may contain.
- `min_length` (Number) The minimum number of characters the generated password must contain.
- `regex_pattern` (String) A regular expression the generated password must match.
- `required_prefix` (String) A string the generated password must start with.
- `required_suffix` (String) A string the generated password must end with.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--constraints--value_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.constraints.value_constraints`

Read-Only:

- `max_length` (Number) The maximum number of characters the secret value may contain.
- `min_length` (Number) The minimum number of characters the secret value must contain.
- `regex_pattern` (String) A regular expression the secret value must match.
- `required_prefix` (String) A string the secret value must start with.
- `required_suffix` (String) A string the secret value must end with.
- `unique_across_last_versions` (Number) How many of the secret's own previous versions the new value must differ from. Null when the rule allows a value that repeats a previous version.
- `unique_within_scope` (Boolean) Whether the rule rejects a value that another secret in the rule's scope already holds. Null when the rule allows a value another secret already holds.



<a id="nestedatt--rules--environment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.environment`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the environment.
- `name` (String) The name of the environment.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the environment.
